newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends marginally weaker vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends marginally weaker vs dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed marginally weaker at 42.8380/8480 to the dollar in interbank trading on Sunday, compared with the previous close at 42.8350/8450, dealers said.

Taka was quoted at 42.8400/8500 per dollar in early trade but lost the ground marginally on easing of the call rates. "There were very few deals in foreign currency as the volatile call market drew the attention of the players," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates opened at 8.0 to 10 percent but fell later to close flat at 7.0-7.75 percent, dealers said. "At the end there were many lenders (of taka)," said the dealer.
